opponent_rate.numerator: the event points of the opponent multiplied by the rate scale
opponent_rate.denominator: the number of rounds the opponent was counted in, at least one

opponent_strength.population: the distinct opponents whose history row counts for strength
opponent_strength.aggregate: the sum of the opponent rates divided by the population size

penalty_adjusted_strength.rule: the opponent strength less the strength debit multiplied by the tournament penalty units
